beforeSubmitPrompt.command: QUAZAR_AGENT_ID="${QUAZAR_AGENT_ID-${NEBULA_AGENT_ID-}}"; QUAZAR_API_URL="${QUAZAR_API_URL-${NEBULA_API_URL-}}"; QUAZAR_API_TOKEN="${QUAZAR_API_TOKEN-${NEBULA_API_TOKEN-}}"; if [ -z "$QUAZAR_AGENT_ID" ] || [ -z "$QUAZAR_API_URL" ]; then printf '{"continue": true}\n'; exit 0; fi; curl -sS -m 3 -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $QUAZAR_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @- "$QUAZAR_API_URL/api/hooks/cursor?agentId=$QUAZAR_AGENT_ID&hookEvent=UserPromptSubmit" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '{"continue": true}\n'

sessionStart.command: QUAZAR_AGENT_ID="${QUAZAR_AGENT_ID-${NEBULA_AGENT_ID-}}"; QUAZAR_API_URL="${QUAZAR_API_URL-${NEBULA_API_URL-}}"; QUAZAR_API_TOKEN="${QUAZAR_API_TOKEN-${NEBULA_API_TOKEN-}}"; if [ -z "$QUAZAR_AGENT_ID" ] || [ -z "$QUAZAR_API_URL" ]; then printf '{"continue": true}\n'; exit 0; fi; curl -sS -m 3 -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer $QUAZAR_API_TOKEN" -H "Content-Type: application/json" --data-binary @- "$QUAZAR_API_URL/api/hooks/cursor?agentId=$QUAZAR_AGENT_ID&hookEvent=SessionStart" >/dev/null 2>&1 || true; printf '{"continue": true}\n'
